subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Technology can open a window.”?
options: That is why Mr. Fan's shop still opens every morning.
Bikes can be taken on the boat before 10:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m.
What students do after the window opens still depends on effort, curiosity, and guidance.
The difference between help and shortcut often depends on what happens after the first answer.
